notes.title: Update 1.1 - Save System And Achievements
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, Dymchick1 is here! 

I'm happy to announce:

FIRST BIG GAME UPDATE


Save system 
You can save your game progress. This is a new feature so the bugs are possible. Tell us your experience! 
Achievements
They are finally fixed. We plan to add more achievements in the future. 
A lot of bug fixes 
Thanks to all users who sent us found bugs! If you find more then go to our Discord https://discord.gg/Jv5pdrK and ping me (Dymchick1) or Oxy949. 


Have a nice day!
